Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Industria prelucrătoare
Location: Cluj-Napoca, Romania
 Department: Automation | Industrial Applications
 Are you a tech-savvy programmer passionate about software architecture and agile development? Ready to build robust apps and support global industrial projects? This opportunity is for you!
 About Us 
 Join a modern, high-impact industrial environment where software does more than run on a screen: it directly supports heavy manufacturing processes and real-world operations. 
 Our software engineering teams connect Information Technology (IT) with Operational Technology (OT), enabling reliable, data-driven and increasingly digital production. From day one, enjoy structured onboarding and hands-on training.
 What We Offer 
 ✔️ Competitive base salary
 ✔️ Performance-based compensation cycles & bonus
 ✔️ MyFlexiBenefits – customizable perks for you and your family
 ✔️ Flexible working programs (teleworking, flexible hours, short day)
 ✔️ Bonuses for Easter, Christmas, Metallurgist Day, and more
 ✔️ 24 days annual vacation
 ✔️ Learning & development opportunities (technical + soft skills)
 ✔️ Certifications & professional growth support
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and develop: Build and maintain Level 2 industrial applications using C#, .NET and Angular, connecting automation systems with manufacturing platforms. 
 Integrate industrial systems: Develop interfaces and data flows between PLCs, Level 2 applications and MES systems to support production processes. 
 Collaborate globally: Work with global and local teams to develop and standardize industrial software solutions. 
 Develop data solutions: Design and optimize SQL Server databases and services for large-scale industrial data management. 
 Modernize the architecture: Support cloud and modernization initiatives using Azure, REST APIs and scalable architectures. 
 Support industrial operations: Troubleshoot and enhance critical production systems in a 24/7 manufacturing environment. 
 Promote engineering excellence: Apply best practices in software development, testing, version control and CI/CD to deliver reliable solutions.
 Your Profile 
 Degree in: Computer Science or Informatics Engineering
 Languages: English – Advanced | Italian – a plus
 Technical Experience: 
Proven experience as a Full Stack Software Developer, Software Engineer or Systems Analyst.
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Framework and/or .NET Core.
Solid knowledge of SQL Server, relational database design and query optimization.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software architecture and the software development lifecycle.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in globally distributed, multidisciplinary teams.
Willingness to travel to manufacturing sites and work hands-on in industrial environments.
 Ready to lead innovative IT projects and build impactful digital solutions?
 Apply now and become part of a global network where your contribution drives progress.
